cohort: 171 multiparous parturients with prior stillbirth and 5,245 without prior stillbirth, all of whom delivered a singleton infant at a tertiary-care hospital from January 2002 to March 2013 and had a past medical/obstetric history of diabetic, and/or hypertensive disorders, and/or pregnancy with fetal growth restriction
finding: High-risk multiparous patients with prior stillbirth had a higher risk of NICU admission and preeclampsia with severe features in subsequent livebirths compared to those without prior stillbirth.
